businesses.business: business and financial advisory consulting firm

offering_description.value: Provides expert advisory and consulting services to corporations, law firms, financial institutions and governments. Services cover corporate finance and restructuring, forensic and litigation consulting, economic consulting, technology and e-discovery, and strategic communications. Delivered by teams of professionals and industry experts on a project or engagement basis.

primary_services.value: corporate finance and restructuring advisory; forensic and litigation consulting; economic consulting; technology and e-discovery services; strategic communications consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: large corporations, law firms, banks, private equity firms, insurers and lenders; B2G: government agencies and public-sector bodies needing investigations, disputes and policy advice

end_markets.value: financial services; legal; energy and power; healthcare and life sciences; construction and infrastructure

revenue_model.value: service fees: hourly and fixed-fee consulting and advisory engagements billed to clients; project or contract: project-based restructuring, investigation and dispute engagements, some success fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: professional staff and experts deliver advisory work to corporations, law firms and financial institutions

geography_served.value: global: offices across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Africa and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: advisory practices: corporate finance, forensic and litigation, economic consulting, technology, strategic communications

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: senior professionals win engagements directly from clients and law firm referrals

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: professional services rules including independence, data privacy, and some licensed practices like investment banking (SEC, FINRA)
